text: This report includes an update on staffing matters.

The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (January 23, 2023) from the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO remain confidential in its entirety as it relates to labour relations and employee negotiations.
